001package iscteiul.ista.battleship;
002
003import java.util.Objects;
004
005/**
006 * Stores a pair of zero-based board coordinates with mutable occupancy and shot flags.
007 * Coordinates are not checked against board boundaries. Equality uses only the
008 * row and column, and adjacency includes overlapping and diagonal positions.
009 */
010public class Position implements IPosition {
011    /** Row coordinate. */
012    private int row;
013    /** Column coordinate. */
014    private int column;
015    /** Whether the position has been marked as occupied. */
016    private boolean isOccupied;
017    /** Whether the position has received a shot. */
018    private boolean isHit;
019
020    /**
021     * Creates an unoccupied position that has not been shot.
022     *
023     * @param row the zero-based row coordinate
024     * @param column the zero-based column coordinate
025     */
026    public Position(int row, int column) {
027        this.row = row;
028        this.column = column;
029        this.isOccupied = false;
030        this.isHit = false;
031    }
032
033    /**
034     * {@inheritDoc}
035     */
036    @Override
037    public int getRow() {
038        return row;
039    }
040
041    /**
042     * {@inheritDoc}
043     */
044    @Override
045    public int getColumn() {
046        return column;
047    }
048
049    /**
050     * Computes a hash from the coordinates and the current occupancy and shot flags.
051     *
052     * @return the hash of the current position state
053     */
054    @Override
055    public int hashCode() {
056        return Objects.hash(column, isHit, isOccupied, row);
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * {@inheritDoc}
061     */
062    @Override
063    public boolean equals(Object otherPosition) {
064        if (this == otherPosition)
065            return true;
066        if (otherPosition instanceof IPosition) {
067            IPosition other = (IPosition) otherPosition;
068            return (this.getRow() == other.getRow() && this.getColumn() == other.getColumn());
069        } else {
070            return false;
071        }
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * {@inheritDoc}
076     */
077    @Override
078    public boolean isAdjacentTo(IPosition other) {
079        return (Math.abs(this.getRow() - other.getRow()) <= 1 && Math.abs(this.getColumn() - other.getColumn()) <= 1);
080    }
081
082    /**
083     * {@inheritDoc}
084     */
085    @Override
086    public void occupy() {
087        isOccupied = true;
088    }
089
090    /**
091     * {@inheritDoc}
092     */
093    @Override
094    public void shoot() {
095        isHit = true;
096    }
097
098    /**
099     * {@inheritDoc}
100     */
101    @Override
102    public boolean isOccupied() {
103        return isOccupied;
104    }
105
106    /**
107     * {@inheritDoc}
108     */
109    @Override
110    public boolean isHit() {
111        return isHit;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * Returns the coordinates with the Portuguese labels {@code Linha} and {@code Coluna}.
116     *
117     * @return a description of the row and column
118     */
119    @Override
120    public String toString() {
121        return ("Linha = " + row + " Coluna = " + column);
122    }
123
124}
